title: Milwaukee Men's Quick Draw Stylesh Leather Vest
description: Quick-Draw Leather Vest - Ride Armed Ride Smart Built for bikers who demand more, the Quick-Draw leather vest offers tactical storage, robust protection and undeniable attitude. Made from thick 1.2-1.3mm full grain nude cowhide leather. This vest offers street grade abrasion resistance and an unbreakable edge. Featuring accordion stretch side panels for a forgiving, body-hugging fit and 8 total pockets, including 2 concealed lockstock carry holsters - it's designed to move with you and keep your essentials close at hand. The holsters feature adjustable pull angles and neoprene snap closure for secure, snag-free access in any position. Stash your gear in 2 chest pockets with hidden zippers, 2 lower handwarmer pockets, a media pocket, and 3 additional stash compartments - because no ride should leave you looking for space. Inside you'll find reinforced leather trims, a breathable mesh lining, and our patented Patch Access technology that allows you to sew on club patches or custom embroidery without damaging the integrity of the vest. Add CE Level 2 back armor (sold separately | Style# MP7912) for added protection. This vest not only looks good, but is also built for performance. KEY FEATURES Premium bare cowhide leather: made of 1.2-1.3mm full grain leather for superior abrasion resistance and long lasting durability. PATENTED LOCKSTOCK HOLSTER:Dual outer concealed holsters with adjustable angles, neoprene straps and snag-free grip for smooth access. 8 Tactical Pockets: 2 chest flap pockets with hidden zippers, 2 lower hand warmer pockets with concealed snaps, a media pocket, 3 additional compartments, 2 outer holster pockets for secure transport. PATENTED PATCH ACCESS TECHNOLOGY Zipper openings allow for easy adjustment of patches or embroidery without damaging the vest. Mesh inner lining: breathable and comfortable for longer rides. Armor-ready back: large CE level 2 armor pocket (Style# MP7912 - sold separately)
Name: Milwaukee Men's Quick Draw Stylesh Leather Vest
